referenceUse: Reference material was used to distinguish subjects and relative layout. Original research photographs are not bundled or republished. Typography, labels and interaction controls are separate from artwork.
limitations: Building scale, water, planting, cranes and distant city are artistic choices.
Stone paths do not constitute verified walkable routes; no compass or navigation promise is presented.
Local fixed responses are separate from authenticated evidence, cloud records and paid model APIs.
The source video informed reveal timing and layered movement only; no video frames or characters are used as site assets.
